events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war shows military strength of the US, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has the potential to escalate and impact global markets. The US has shown its military might, but the war also reveals the limits of US power.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to higher oil prices. This could negatively impact emerging markets, making EEM a short target. On the other hand, higher oil prices could benefit oil-related ETFs like DBO, making it a buy target.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the conflict escalation and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or oil prices stabilize

gains.extendedNote: If the conflict escalates and oil prices surge
